_note: RC-149 (W21-04), 2026-09-17. Product records for the seven catalog category pages, STRUCTURE ONLY. Every array is empty on purpose: the card is BLOCKED on the product list itself and forbids inventing one. The wave 14 audit records products from three other companies (Dasterum tiles, Imperlux fences and carports, a Fațade 3D own-brand membrane) and scripts/check-catalog-pages.js already refuses those manufacturer names on these pages, so none of them is a Rapid Construct catalog record. See docs/QUESTIONS.md Q-W21-01. Shape, per category slug: [ { id, name: {ro, ru}, manufacturer, pack: {ro, ru}, spec: {ro, ru} } ]. build.js renders the section only where the array has records, refuses a record whose name, pack or spec is not real in both locales, and refuses a manufacturer the catalog gate forbids. Images are requested through docs/assets/CATALOG-IMAGE-SLOTS.md (RC-150) and rendered only once an approved source exists.
